comparison.objective: Start and tighten a confined-access bracket bolt with a socket ratchet, then return the tool.
comparison.physical_skill: Socket engagement, screw starting, short ratcheting strokes between walls, and tool withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Versions range from an explicitly unqualified planned rubric to final seating/contact, tool removal, stable release, and thread-integrity checks; early versions lack a qualified live scorer.
comparison.reason: Confined ratcheting and threaded fastening are clearly unrelated to selective sifting, even though both use a manipulated tool.
